entries.21a3df1a57f5eb03: The company belongs to the AEON Group, a corporate group centered on [[company:aeon|AEON CO.,LTD.]], and is positioned as the core company of the Group in Kyushu. The consolidation covers one [[term:consolidated-subsidiary|consolidated subsidiary]], AEON Welcia Kyushu Co., Ltd. (which operates Drug & Food stores; the company's voting rights ownership ratio is 51.0%). As of February 28, 2026, the number of employees on a consolidated basis was 5,431 (including 58 seconded from parent companies and other entities), and the average number of community staff (part-time employees) converted to 8-hour days was 13,495 (outside the total). The basic management policy, rooted in “Everything for the customer”, is to continuously pursue “transformation” and “challenge” to achieve customer satisfaction and employees' self-fulfillment, and to contribute to Kyushu's growth and the enrichment of daily life.

entries.33d168cbb22b255b: Net sales of clothing in the fiscal year ended February 2026 were ¥41,280 million (¥41,636 million in the previous year, 99.1% of the previous year). The Business Description section lists, under clothing, clothing, shoes, bags, apparel accessories, etc. The management analysis states that although an early rollout of summer items was planned, temperatures in April and May were low and the response on pricing was delayed while rising prices put pressure on household budgets, so sales struggled particularly in the first quarter. It explains that existing-store sales (clothing and housing and leisure goods) from the second quarter onward were roughly level with the previous year. As its own initiatives, it cites the expansion of "Kiru Oshikatsu" (wearable fan-activity items), collaboration products with companies and manufacturers familiar in Kyushu, and of the company's original brand "Urban Smart."
entries.4070e8675bdd1364: Operating profit was ¥10,748 million (102.0% year on year) and ordinary profit was ¥11,506 million (104.4%); both reached record highs, as did operating revenue. Profit attributable to owners of the parent was ¥5,971 million (98.9% year on year). The gross profit margin fell 0.2 percentage points from the previous year, due in part to a higher sales mix of food products, but gross profit rose to 102.3% of the previous year as sales increased. Selling, general and administrative expenses were held to 102.2% of the previous year, despite upfront investments such as new store openings and wage increases. Through measures such as replacing self-checkout registers and introducing labor-saving fixtures, total labor hours in stores were reduced, and labor-hour productivity rose to 104.7% of the previous year.

entries.6d4e5ed4f111eaac: Net sales of home center goods in the fiscal year ended February 2026 were ¥16,670 million (¥17,180 million in the previous year, 97.0% of the previous year). The Business Description section states that home centers sell building materials, lumber, repair materials, household goods, pet supplies, gardening supplies, food, etc. The management analysis states that in the home care division, which has a high share of the sales mix, there was a reaction to disaster-prevention-related demand accompanying the Hyuganada earthquake and typhoons that occurred in 2024, and overall sales were sluggish. On the other hand, it explains that sales in the green (gardening) division exceeded the previous year, owing to factors such as the expanded rollout of vegetable seedlings and home garden kits.

entries.f54d76dac778a7b5: The Group belongs to the AEON Group, a corporate group centered on its parent company [[company:aeon|AEON CO.,LTD.]], and as a core company of the Group in the Kyushu region, it operates a retail business selling clothing, food, housing and leisure goods, home center goods, and more. The Business Description section of the securities report states that, by the products sold and the form of sale, it mainly operates the "supermarkets and discount stores, general merchandise stores (SM/DS, GMS)," "home centers (HC)," and "drug & food" businesses, and it omits segment information because businesses other than "SM/DS, GMS" are of little importance as [[term:segment|segment]] disclosure information. Drug & food is described as the business of the consolidated subsidiary Aeon Welcia Kyushu Co., Ltd. (the company holds 51.0% of the voting rights). For this reason, the securities report has no net sales by business category. Net sales are shown by product category (food, clothing, etc.), and operating revenue, which is net sales plus other operating revenue, is shown with a breakdown. For the fiscal year ended February 2026, net sales were ¥520,588 million and operating revenue was ¥547,145 million (102.9% of the previous year). As of February 28, 2026, the number of stores was 348 (332 of the filing company and 16 of Aeon Welcia Kyushu, excluding 7 stores of the non-consolidated subsidiary Joyful Sun Co., Ltd.).
